Telangana Minister Claims Staff Attacked, Opposition Accuses Congress

Telangana Minister K. T. Rama Rao claimed his staff were attacked at a police station, stating the state was on the brink of chaos. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) accused the ruling Congress party of corruption in Telangana. The BJP also sought official observance of Telangana Liberation Day on September 17. Meanwhile, the Telangana High Court requested details regarding school timings and teachers' duties for Backward Classes (BC) schools.
